title: The_Everything_Mod
description: Hey, welcome! This is my official mod where I add my followers ideas to minecraft!
body:
This is a mod where I add your ideas to minecraft! It includes very random and unhinged things for now such as:
Pizza, blueberries, more new foods;
An Rocket Launcher that shoots other rocket launchers that explodes!
Systems like eating a chorous fruit makes you explode;
touching water makes a quack sound, 
new entities like gooses,
and lets go gambling sound when opened a trade menu with a villager!
These are just the tip of the iceberg and includes many more new items, systems, features and so much more that make the game more entertaining I guess :) Special thanks to everyone who has contributed to the mod with their ideas!
